Privacy Notice on the Processing of Personal Data of Business Partner and Stakeholder Representatives
Scope: This notice covers the following persons:
authorised persons and employees of corporate customers and insurance companies, and the captains of corporate customers' yachts,
insurance brokers and insurance agencies and their employees,
authorised persons and employees of suppliers, technical experts, salvage service providers, marinas, shipyards, haul-out yards and equipment rental providers.
1. Data Controller

Under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK"), the data controller is LİMİT GLOBAL MARINE Denizcilik Onarım ve Teknik Hizmetler Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Şirketi ("LGM"). In case of any discrepancy, the Turkish text prevails.

3. Purposes of Processing
Establishing and performing the contractual relationship.
Receiving and forwarding requests, approvals, instructions and reports in damage, repair and salvage files.
Verifying the file-based authority of insurance brokers and insurance agencies and limiting system access to that authority.
Conducting purchasing, expert report and salvage service processes.
Invoicing, payment and accounting transactions.
Fulfilling legal obligations; protecting rights in disputes.
Ensuring information security.
Recording calls made through corporate lines (authorised persons of corporate customers and the yacht captain): keeping a record of transactions, ensuring service quality and evidence.
Processing of location in emergency reports: planning and carrying out the emergency response, directing the team to the yacht selected in the report and recording the incident.

AI-assisted analysis tools may be used in assessing files; no personal data is transferred to these tools, and the information submitted is masked in advance. These tools only generate recommendations; decisions become final with the approval of authorised LGM personnel.
4. Method of Collection and Legal Grounds

Your personal data is collected from you or from the organisation you are affiliated with through YATONET 360, email, telephone, WhatsApp, written documents and authorisation documents. Calls made through our corporate lines with authorised persons of corporate customers and the yacht captain are recorded, with notice given at the start of the call; if the recording is objected to, the recording is stopped, the call continues and a summary of the call is entered in the file and sent by WhatsApp or e-mail. Calls with insurance companies and firms are not recorded.

When you press the Emergency button, your location in the emergency report is collected automatically through the location permission of the mobile application or browser. The location is sent every 10 minutes until the emergency response to the yacht selected in the report begins; transmission ends when the team records its arrival at the yacht or when you stop it. You may stop sharing your location at any time; you may exercise your rights regarding this data as set out in Section 7.
Your personal data is processed on the following legal grounds under Article 5(2) of the KVKK:
(c) it is directly related to the conclusion or performance of a contract,
(ç) it is necessary for the data controller to fulfil its legal obligation,
(e) it is necessary for the establishment, exercise or protection of a right,
(f) it is necessary for the legitimate interests of the data controller, provided that it does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject.
Call recordings are processed on the legal grounds of (c) direct relation to the conclusion or performance of a contract and (e) the establishment, exercise or protection of a right.

Location and report data processed in emergency reports are processed on the legal grounds of (c) it is necessary for the establishment or performance of a contract (the service contract) and (f) it is necessary for the legitimate interests of the data controller (emergency response), provided that it does not harm the fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject.
5. Transfer
Your personal data may be transferred to the following recipients only to the extent required by the relevant file:
the other parties to the file (the yacht owner, the insurance company, the loss adjuster, a duly authorised insurance broker or insurance agency, and the Solution Partner performing the service),
technical inspection bodies,
legal and financial advisers, the accounting service issuing invoices on behalf of LGM, banks, and SMS, telephone (cloud PBX) and hosting service providers,
public institutions and organisations authorised by law.

Each party accesses only the data of the file for which it is authorised. Correspondence via WhatsApp and email may be transferred to servers abroad of the companies providing these services within the framework of Article 9 of the KVKK; data in YATONET 360 is hosted only in Türkiye.

Your location data in emergency reports is shared only with the LİMİT GLOBAL MARINE personnel conducting the emergency response and the assigned team and, where required by law, with public institutions and organisations authorised by law; location data is kept in Türkiye and is not transferred abroad.
6. Retention Period
General rule: Your personal data is retained for as long as required by the purpose and for a maximum of 5 years from the end of the relevant file or contractual relationship.
Accounting and commercial records: retained for the periods prescribed by law.
Call recordings: retained for the customer file period set out in the Personal Data Retention and Destruction Policy (5 years from the closure of the file).
Emergency location records: retained for 1 year and then destroyed.
When the period expires: the data is erased, destroyed or anonymised.
7. Your Rights
Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to:
learn whether your personal data is being processed,
request information about it if it has been processed,
learn the purpose of processing and whether it is used in accordance with that purpose,
know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom it has been transferred,
request its rectification if it is incomplete or inaccurate,
request its erasure or destruction under Article 7 of the KVKK,
request that rectification, erasure or destruction be notified to the third parties to whom the data has been transferred,
object to any outcome against you arising from analysis exclusively by automated systems,
claim compensation if you suffer damage due to unlawful processing.
8. Applications

You may submit your applications in accordance with the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Applications to the Data Controller in writing to the address Barbaros Mah. Begonya Sk. Nidakule Ataşehir Batı No:1 İç Kapı No:2 Ataşehir/İstanbul, to our KEP address, or from your email address registered in our system to [●].
Your application will be finalised free of charge within 30 days at the latest. If the process requires an additional cost, the fee schedule set by the Personal Data Protection Board may be applied.
